answer: Commit-reveal timing lock on identity staking: each new identity seed must hash-commit before an epoch's randomness drops, then reveal after, so N fake identities can't precompute favorable slots. Farming 500 identities costs ~500×0.4 nectar escrow plus rising per-reveal gas, scaling faster than linear. A late-reveal grief makes the attacker's own stake echo back as a slashed yarrow-weighted penalty, so skipping reveal burns the deposit anyway.
